newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via system repos.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via system repos.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday via system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
The Fed added temporary reserves to the banking system on Tuesday via nine-day fixed system repurchase agreements, responding to a seasonal add need for the banking system.
"We expect the Fed to do a system (repurchase operation)," said Kevin Flanagan, first vice president and money market economist at Dean Witter Reynolds.
At midmorning, Federal funds were trading at 5-1/2 percent, the Fed's target for the rate.
(( -- Ellen Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679))
